7.3.1.v: When a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् follows, आ is substituted instead of वृद्धि for the first vowels of the following - 1. देविका 2. शिंशपा 3. दित्यवाट् 4. दीर्घसत्र and 5. श्रेयस।

7.3.2.v: Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् the वृद्धि is not substituted for the first vowel in a compound when it follows a word ending in य् or व् but ऐ and औ are respectively placed before the semi-vowels.

7.3.3.v: Before a तद्धित affix with an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् the वृद्धि is not substituted for the first vowel in a compound when it follows a word ending in य् or व् but ऐ and औ are respectively placed before the semi-vowels.

7.3.4.v: Before a तद्धित affix with an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् the वृद्धि is not substituted for the first vowel after य् or व् but ऐ and औ are respectively placed before the semi-vowels in द्वार etc.

7.3.5.v: ऐ is placed before the य् of न्यग्रोध instead of वृद्धि when the word stands alone and is not a member of a compound and is followed by a तद्धित affix with the indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् ।

7.3.6.v: The prohibition and the augment ordained by न य्वाभ्यां पदान्ताभ्याम् पूर्वौ तु ताभ्यामैच् [[7.3.3]], do not apply to a word which expresses the reciprocity of an action.

7.3.7.v: The prohibition and the augment ordained by न य्वाभ्यां पदान्ताभ्याम् पूर्वौ तु ताभ्यामैच् [[7.3.3]], do not apply also to स्वागत etc.

7.3.8.v: A compound beginning with श्वन् and followed by the तद्धित affix इञ् is not governed by the prohibition nor takes the augment taught in द्वारादीनां च [[7.3.4]].

7.3.9.v: The sūtra द्वारादीनां च [[7.3.4]] is optionally applied to श्वन् followed by पद।

7.3.10.v: Up to यथातथयथापुरयोः पर्यायेण [[7.3.31]] inclusive, the substitution of वृद्धि will take place for the first vowel of the second member in a compound.
7.3.10.e: This is an अधिकार, which spans till  'यथातथयथापुरयोः पर्यायेण' 7.3.31. Whatever is being told in this अधिकार happens only to an उत्तरपद.
7.3.10.sa: अधिकारोऽयम् । इतः परम् 'यथातथयथापुरयोः पर्यायेण' [[7.3.31]] इति यावत् यत् किमपि उक्तमस्ति तत् उत्तरपदस्यैव भवति ।
7.3.10.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.11.v: Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowel of a word denoting season when it is preceded by a word denoting a part.

7.3.12.v: After 1. सु 2. सर्व and 3. अर्ध the first vowel of the name of a country gets the वृद्धि when a तद्धित affix with an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् follows.

7.3.13.v: After a word denoting direction, the first vowel of the name of a country with the exception of मद्र gets वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् ।

7.3.14.v: After a word denoting direction, the first vowel of the name of a village or city in the land of the Eastern people, gets the वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् ।

7.3.15.v: After a numeral, the first vowel of संवत्सर and of a numeral, gets वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् ।

7.3.16.v: After a numeral, the first vowel of वर्ष gets वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् when the affix does not refer to a Future time.

7.3.17.v: After a numeral, the first vowel of a word denoting mass in its widest sense (with the exception of शाण) gets the वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् when the word so formed does not mean a Name.

7.3.18.v: In प्रोष्ठपद and its synonyms, the first vowel of the second member gets the वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix meaning 'born in that time' and having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् ।

7.3.19.v: The वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowels of both (the first and second) members in a compound ending with 1. हृद् 2. भग and 3. सिन्धु before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् ।

7.3.20.v: Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् , the वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowel of both members of the compounds अनुशतिका etc.

7.3.21.v: Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् , the वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowels of both members of द्वन्द समास of the names of देवता-s।

7.3.22.v: But the वृद्धि of the first vowel of इन्द्र when it stands as the second member of a द्वन्द समास , does not take place before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् ।

7.3.23.v: Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् in a द्वन्द समास of god-names, the वृद्धि is not substituted for the first vowel of वरुण when a long vowel precedes it.

7.3.24.v: Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् the वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowels of both members of the compound which is the name of a city of the Eastern people and which ends in the word नगर।

7.3.25.v: Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् the वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowel of the compound ending in 1. जङ्गल 2. धेनु and 3. बलज and optionally for the first vowel of these second members also.

7.3.26.v: Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् the वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowel of the second member, denoting a mass in its widest sense when the word अर्ध precedes it, but optionally for the first vowel of अर्ध।

7.3.27.v: When the first vowel of the second member preceded by अर्ध and denoting mass is short अ before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् and optionally so for the first vowel of the first member (i.e. अर्ध).

7.3.28.v: Before the affix ढ (एय), the वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowel of the second member of प्रवाहण but optionally so for the first member (i.e. प्र).

7.3.29.v: Even so from a new derivative from this stem ending in ढ, formed with a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् there is वृद्धि substitution for the first vowel of the second member and optionally for the first vowel of the first member in प्रवाहणेय and प्रावाहणेय।

7.3.30.v: Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् , the वृद्धि is always substituted for the first vowel of 1. शुचि 2. ईश्वर 3. क्षेत्रज्ञ 4. कुशल and 4. निपुण when preceded by the Negative particle, but this substitution is optional for the vowel of the Negative particles.

7.3.31.v: Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् , the words यथातथ and यथापुर may have वृद्धि of the first vowel of their first member or that of the second member, in alteration.

7.3.32.v: त् is substituted for the न् of the root हन् 'to kill' before an affix with a indicatory ञ् or ण् which also causes वृद्धि of the penultimate अ , but the augment is not added before the Aorist sign nor before the Personal ending णल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

7.3.33.v: A root-अङ्ग (stem) ending in आ gets the augment युक् (य्) before the Aorist sign चिण् which causes also the वृद्धि of the root-vowel.

7.3.34.v: The वृद्धि is not substituted before the Aorist sign चिण् or a कृत् affix with an indicatory ञ् or ण् for the vowel of that root which ends in म and is acutely accented (उदात्त) in its original enunciation (धातुपाठ), but not so in चम् after आ।

7.3.35.v: The वृद्धि is not substituted for the vowels of जन् 'to produce' and वधे before the Aorist sign चिण् and the कृत् affixes with an indicatory ञ् or ण् ।

7.3.36.v: The augment पुक् (प्) is added to the roots 1. ऋ 2. ह्री 3. व्ली 4. री 5. क्नुय् 6. क्ष्माय and to a root ending in long आ when the affix णि (the Causative) follows.

7.3.37.v: The augment युक् (य्) is added to the verbal stems 1. शा 2. छा 3. सा 4. ह्वा 5. वे and 6. पा before the affix णि (Causative).

7.3.38.v: वा gets the augment जुक् (ज्) before the affix णि when the Causative has the sense of 'shaking'.

7.3.39.v: The roots ली and ला optionally get नुक् and लुक् augment respectively before the affix णि when the Causative means 'the melting of a fatty substance'.

7.3.40.v: The augment षुक् is added to the root भी before the affix णि when fear is caused immediately owing to the agent of the Causative.

7.3.41.v: For the final of the stem स्फाय् is substituted व् in the Causative.

7.3.42.v: For the final of शद् is substituted त् in the Causative, when it does not mean 'to drive'.

7.3.43.v: प् may optionally be substituted for the final of रुह् 'to mount' in the Causative.

7.3.44.v: इ is substituted for the अ which stands before the क् belonging to an affix when the feminine ending आ follows, provided that, it does not come after a case-affix (i.e. when such a word in अक does not stand at the end of a बहुव्रीहि समास).

7.3.45.v: The इ is not substituted for the अ of य् and स् with the augment क् when the feminine आ follows.

7.3.46.v: According to the opinion of Northern Grammarians इ is not substituted for that अ which is obtained by shortening the long आ of the feminine (under sūtra केऽणः [[7.4.13]] before the affix क) which is preceded by य् or a क्।

7.3.47.v: According to the opinion of Northern Grammarians इ is not substituted for that अ which is obtained by shortening the long आ of the feminine (under sūtra केऽणः [[7.4.13]]) of 1. भस्त्रा 2. एषा 3. अजा 4. ज्ञा 5. द्वा -- त्यदादीनामः [[7.2.102]], and 6. स्वा even not then when the negative particle precedes them.

7.3.48.v: According to the opinion of Northern Grammarians इ is not substituted for that अ which is obtained by shortening the long आ of the feminine (under sūtra केऽणः [[7.4.13]]) when to the feminine in long आ there is no equivalent masculine, even when the negative particle precedes.

7.3.49.v: According to the opinion of other Teachers, आ is substituted for the which is obtained by shortening the long आ of the feminine (under sūtra केऽणः [[7.4.13]]) of a word which has no corresponding masculine form.

7.3.50.v: For ठ at the beginning of a तद्धित affix there is substituted इक्।
7.3.50.e: A ठकार present at the beginning of a प्रत्यय is converted to 'इक्'.
7.3.50.sa: अङ्गात् परस्य प्रत्ययस्य आदौ विद्यमानस्य  ठकारस्य 'इक्' आदेशः भवति ।
7.3.50.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.51.v: क is substituted for ठ after a अङ्ग (stem) ending in 1. इस् 2. उस् 3. उ or ऊ 4. ॠ and 5. त्।
7.3.51.e:
A ठकार present at the beginning of a प्रत्यय is converted to 'क्' for an इस्-प्रत्ययान्त अङ्ग, उस्-प्रत्ययान्त अङ्ग, 
उक्-वर्णान्त अङ्ग and तकारान्त अङ्ग.
7.3.51.sa: इस्/उस्-प्रत्ययान्त-अङ्गात् , तकारान्त-अङ्गात्, तथा च उक्-प्रत्याहारस्य वर्णः यस्य अन्ते अन्ति तादृशात् अङ्गात् परस्य प्रत्ययस्य आदौ विद्यमानस्य ठकारस्य ककारादेशः भवति ।
7.3.51.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.52.v: For the final च् or ज् of a root, there is substituted a corresponding guttural, before an affix having an indicatory ध् and before ण्यत्।

7.3.53.v: The guttural is substituted in न्यङ्क्वु etc..

7.3.54.v: A guttural is substituted for the ह् in हन् 'to kill' before an affix having an indicatory ञ् or ण् and before न्।
7.3.54.e: The हकार of the verb हन् undergoes  कुत्वम् in presence of (1) a ञित्-प्रत्यय, (2) a णित्-प्रत्यय, (3) a नकार.
7.3.54.sa: हन्-धातोः अङ्गस्य हकारस्य कुत्वम् भवति ञित्-प्रत्यये परे, णित्-प्रत्यये परे, नकारे परे ।
7.3.54.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.55.v: A guttural is substituted for the ह् in हन् 'to kill' after reduplication also.

7.3.56.v: A guttural is substituted for the ह् of हि (हिनोति) after a reduplication, but not in the reduplicated Aorist.

7.3.57.v: ज् in जि 'to conquer' after a reduplication before the Desiderative affix सन् and in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

7.3.58.v: A guttural is optionally substituted for the च् of चि 'to collect' after a reduplication in Desiderative and लिट् (Perfect Tense).

7.3.59.v: A guttural is not substituted for the final च् or ज् of a root which begins with a guttural, before the affix having an indicatory ध् and before ण्यत्।

7.3.60.v: A guttural is not substituted for the final ज् of अज् and व्रज् before an affix having an indicatory ध् and before ण्यत्।

7.3.61.v: भुज 'an arm' and न्युब्ज 'a kind of bodily disease' are irregularly formed without any change of their ज् before घञ्।

7.3.62.v: प्रयाज and अनुयाज are irregularly formed with घञ् when meaning 'a portion of a sacrificial offering'.

7.3.63.v: A guttural is not substituted for the palatal of वञ्च् in the sense of 'going'.

7.3.64.v: ओक is irregularly formed from the root उच् with the affix क (अ).

7.3.65.v: A guttural is not substituted for the palatal before the affix ण्य when it means 'to do as absolute necessity'.

7.3.66.v: A guttural is not substituted for the final palatals of 1. यज् 2. याच् 3. रुच् 4. प्र-वच् and 5. ऋच् before the affix ण्यत्।

7.3.67.v: A guttural is not substituted for the final of वच् before ण्यत् when it does not mean 'a word or speech'.

7.3.68.v: प्रयोज्य and नियोज्य preserve their palatal in the sense of 'capable to do this'.

7.3.69.v: भोज्य preserves its palatal in the sense of 'eatable'.

7.3.70.v: The final of दा and धा (धु roots) may optionally be elided in the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive).

7.3.71.v: A अङ्ग (stem) ending in ओ loses its final before the Present characteristic श्यन् of the दिवादिगणः (4th Conjugation).

7.3.72.v: The अ of the Aorist characteristic कस् is elided before an affix beginning with a vowel.

7.3.73.v: The whole of the affix क्स is optionally elided before the personal endings of आत्मनेपद beginning with a dental, after 1. दुह् 2. दिह् 3. लिह् and 4. गुह्।

7.3.74.v: Before the Present characteristic श्यन् , a long is substituted for the root-vowel in शम् and the seven roots that follow it.

7.3.75.v: Before any other Present character (शित्) the root vowel of 1. ष्ठिव् 2. क्लम् and 3.आ-चम् is lengthened.

7.3.76.v: The long is substituted in क्रम् before a शित् affix, in the परस्मैपद ।

7.3.77.v: छ् is substituted for the final of 1. इष् 2. गम् and 3. यम् before a Present-character (शित्).

7.3.78.v: Before a Present-character (शित्) the following substitutions take place - 1. पिब् for पा 2. जिघ्र for घ्रा 3. धम् for ध्मा 4. तिष्ठ् for स्था 5. मन् for म्ना 6. यछ् for दा (दाण्) 7. पश्य for दृश् 8. ऋच्छ् for ऋ 9. धौ for सृ 10. शीय् for शद् and 11. सीद् for सद्।

7.3.79.v: Before a शित् affix, जा is substituted for ज्ञा and जन्।

7.3.80.v: A short is substituted for पू etc. before a शित् affix.

7.3.81.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) मी is shortened before a शित् affix.

7.3.82.v: For इ in मिद् there is substituted a गुण before a शित् affix.

7.3.83.v: Before a personal ending जुस् (उस्) of the Imperfect, गुण is substituted for the final 1. इ 2. ई 3. उ. 4. ऊ 5. ऋ 6. ॠ and 7. ऌ।

7.3.84.v: The गुण is substituted for the final इक् vowel of a अङ्ग (stem) before the affixes called सार्वधातुक and आर्धधातुक -- तिङ्शित्सार्वधातुकम् [[3.4.113]] etc.
7.3.84.e: When followed by an सार्वधातुक or an आर्धधातुक प्रत्यय, an इगन्त अङ्ग gets a गुणादेश.
7.3.84.sa: सार्वधातुके आर्धधातुके च प्रत्यये परे इगन्तस्य अङ्गस्य गुणादेशः भवति ।
7.3.84.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.85.v: The गुण is substituted for the ऋ of the अङ्ग (stem) जागृ , except before the affix वि , before the Aorist character (चिण्) before the personal ending णल् of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) and before an affix with an indicatory ङ्।

7.3.86.v: गुण is substituted before a सार्वधातुक and an आर्धधातुक affix for the इक् vowels of the Causative अङ्ग (stems) which take the augment प् -- अर्त्तिह्रीब्लीरीक्नूयीक्ष्माय्यातां पुङ्णौ [[7.3.36]], and for the short penultimate vowel of a root which ends in a single consonant.
7.3.86.e: When followed by a सार्वधातुक or an आर्धधातुक  प्रत्यय, a पुगन्त अङ्ग and a लघूपध अङ्ग get a गुणादेश.
7.3.86.sa: सार्वधातुके आर्धधातुके च प्रत्यये परे पुगन्तस्य तथा लघूपधस्य अङ्गस्य गुणादेशः भवति ।
7.3.86.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.87.v: The गुण is not substituted for the penultimate light इक् vowel in the reduplicated form of a root, before a सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a vowel and having an indicatory प्।

7.3.88.v: भू and सु get not गुण before an immediately following personal ending which is सार्वधातुक ।
7.3.88.e: For the verbs भू and सु, the अङ्ग does not undergo a गुण when followed by a सार्वधातुक तिङ्-प्रत्यय.
7.3.88.sa: भू-धातोः तथा सु-धातोः अङ्गस्य सार्वधातुके तिङ्-प्रत्यये परे गुणः न भवति ।
7.3.88.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.89.v: A root ending in short उ , which has no Present characteristic (i.e. the विकरण is dropped by लुक् elision) gets वृद्धि before a पित् सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a consonant, but not if the अङ्ग (stem) is reduplicated.

7.3.90.v: Before a पित् सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a consonant, the final उ of ऊर्णु optionally gets वृद्धि ।

7.3.91.v: Before a पित् सार्वधातुक affix which is a single consonant, गुण is substituted for the final of ऊर्णु ।

7.3.92.v: Before a पित् सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a consonant, इ is added after अ of the verbal stem तृणह्।

7.3.93.v: Before a पित् सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a consonant, the augment इट् is placed after ब्रू।
7.3.93.e: A सार्वधातुक पित् प्रत्यय which begins with a हल्-letter gets  ईट्  आगम when attached to the verb ब्रू.
7.3.93.sa: ब्रू-धातोः अङ्गात् परस्य सार्वधातुक-हलादि-पित्-प्रत्ययस्य ईट्-आगमः भवति ।
7.3.93.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.94.v: The पित् सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a consonant, optionally get the augment इट् in the Intensive.
7.3.94.e: A हलादि-पित्-सार्वधातुकप्रत्यय attached to a यङ्-प्रत्ययान्त-अङ्ग gets ईडागम optionally.
7.3.94.sa: यङ्-प्रत्ययान्त-अङ्गात् परस्य हलादि-पित्-सार्वधातुकप्रत्ययस्य विकल्पेन ईडागमः भवति ।
7.3.94.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.95.v: A सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a consonant, optionally get the augment इट् after the roots 1. तु 2. रु 3. स्तु 4. शम् and 5. अम्।
7.3.95.e: A हलादि सार्वधातुक तिङ् प्रत्यय optionally gets an ईट् आगम when it is attached to the verbs तु, रु, स्तु, शम्, अम्
7.3.95.sa: तु, रु, स्तु, शम्, अम्  -  एतेभ्यः परस्य हलादि-सार्वधातुक-तिङ्-प्रत्ययस्य विकल्पेन ईट्-आगमः भवति ।
7.3.95.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.96.v: A single consonantal सार्वधातुक affix gets the augment ईट् after अस् (अस्ति) and after the Aorist character सिच् ।
7.3.96.e: A सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय which contains only one हल् letter (and no अच् letter) gets an  'ईट्' आगम when it follows either the अस् धातु or the  सिच्-प्रत्यय.
7.3.96.sa: अस्-धातोः अङ्गात् परस्य तथा सिच्-प्रत्ययान्त-अङ्गात् परस्य सार्वधातुकस्य अपृक्त-हल्-प्रत्ययस्य ईट्-आगमः भवति ।
7.3.96.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.97.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), a single consonantal सार्वधातुक affix gets diversely the augment after अस् (अस्ति) and after the Aorist character सिच् ।
7.3.97.e: In the context of vedas - a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय which contains only one हल् letter (and no अच् letter) might or might not get an 'ईट्' आगम when it follows either the अस् धातु or the सिच्-प्रत्यय.
7.3.97.sa: अस्-धातोः अङ्गात् परस्य तथा सिच्-प्रत्ययान्त-अङ्गात् परस्य सार्वधातुकस्य अपृक्त-हल्-प्रत्ययस्य वेदेषु ईट्-आगमः बहुलं दृश्यते ।
7.3.97.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.98.v: After रुद् and the four roots that follow it, comes the augment ईट् consisting of a single consonant.
7.3.98.e: A सार्वधातुक-पित्-अपृक्त-हल्-प्रत्यय that follows the verbs रुद्, स्वप् , श्वस्, प्रण्, जक्ष् gets an  ईट् आगम.
7.3.98.sa: रुद्, स्वप् , श्वस्, प्रण्, जक्ष् - एतेभ्यः अङ्गात् परस्य सार्वधातुक-पित्-अपृक्त-हल्-प्रत्ययस्य ईट्-आगमः भवति ।
7.3.98.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.99.v: According to the opinion of गार्ग्य and गालाव , the augment अट् comes before a सार्वधातुक affix consisting of single consonant, after the above five roots रुद् etc.
7.3.99.e: A सार्वधातुक-पित्-अपृक्त-हल्-प्रत्यय that follows the verbs रुद्, स्वप् , श्वस्, प्रण्, जक्ष् optionally gets an अट् आगम.
7.3.99.sa: रुद्, स्वप् , श्वस्, प्रण्, जक्ष् - एतेभ्यः अङ्गात् परस्य सार्वधातुक-पित्-अपृक्त-हल्-प्रत्ययस्य गार्ग्य-गालवयोः मतेन अट्-आगमः भवति ।
7.3.99.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.100.v: After अद् 'to eat' , comes the augment अट् before a सार्वधातुक affix consisting of a single consonant, according to the opinion of all grammarians.
7.3.100.e: A सार्वधातुक-अपृक्त-प्रत्यय that follows the verb  अद् gets an  अट् आगम.
7.3.100.sa: अद्-धातोः अङ्गात् परस्य सार्वधातुक-अपृक्त-प्रत्ययस्य सर्वेषामाचार्याणाम् मतेन अट्-आगमः भवति ।
7.3.100.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.101.v: The long आ is substituted for the final अ of a tense अङ्ग (stem) before a सार्वधातुक affix beginning with a व् or म् (literally a consonant of यञ् प्रत्यहार).
7.3.101.e: The last letter of an अदन्त अङ्ग becomes दीर्घ when followed by a यञादि सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय.
7.3.101.sa: यञादि-सार्वधातुके प्रत्यये परे अदन्तस्य अङ्गस्य अन्तिमवर्णस्य दीर्घादेशः भवति ।
7.3.101.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.102.v: Before a case-ending beginning with य् or भ् (literally a consonant of the यञ् प्रत्यहार) the final of a Nominal-stem is lengthened.
7.3.102.e: The last letter of an अदन्त अङ्ग  becomes दीर्घ when followed by a यञादि सुप्-प्रत्यय.
7.3.102.sa: यञादि सुप्-प्रत्यये परे अदन्तस्य अङ्गस्य दीर्घादेशः भवति ।
7.3.102.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.103.v: Before a case-ending beginning with भ् or स् (literally a consonant of the झल् प्रत्यहार) in the plural, ए is substituted for the final अ of Nominal-stem.
7.3.103.e: The last letter of an अदन्त अङ्ग gets an एकारादेश when followed by a सुप्-प्रत्यय which begins with a झल letter and which represents बहुवचन.
7.3.103.sa: 'बहुवचनस्य झलादि सुप्-प्रत्यये परे' अदन्तस्य अङ्गस्य एकारादेशः भवति ।
7.3.103.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.104.v: Before the case-ending ओस् , ए is substituted for the final अ of Nominal-stem.
7.3.104.e: An अदन्त अङ्ग gets a एकारादेश in presence of the ओस्-प्रत्यय.
7.3.104.sa: अदन्तस्य अङ्गस्य ओस्-प्रत्यये परे एकारादेशः भवति ।
7.3.104.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.105.v: Before the case-ending ओस् and before आ of the Instrumental -3rd case, ए is substituted for the final आ of the feminine affix.
7.3.105.e: An आबन्त अङ्ग gets एकारादेश in presence of the ओस् and टा प्रत्यय.
7.3.105.sa: षष्ठीसप्तमीद्विवचनस्य ओस्-प्रत्यये परे, तथा च तृतीयैकवचनस्य टा-प्रत्यये परे आबन्तस्य अङ्गस्य एकारादेशः भवति ।
7.3.105.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.106.v: ए is substituted for the final आ of the feminine affix, in the Vocative Case singular.
7.3.106.e: An आबन्त अङ्ग gets an एकारादेश in presence of the  सुँ-प्रत्यय of  सम्बोधन-एकवचन.
7.3.106.sa: आबन्तस्य अङ्गस्य सम्बुद्धि-एकवचनस्य प्रत्यये परे एकारादेशः भवति ।
7.3.106.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.107.v: A short vowel is substituted in the Vocative Case singular for the final आ of the feminine affix, in the sense of 'mother, mother-dear' and also for the long vowel of the feminines called नदी -- यू स्त्र्याख्यौ नदी [[1.4.3]] etc.
7.3.107.e: For the words that are used with the meaning same as अम्बा, and for the words that get the नदीसंज्ञा, the अङ्ग get a ह्रस्वादेश in presence of  सुँ-प्रत्यय of सम्बोधन-एकवचन.
7.3.107.sa: 'अम्बा' अस्मिन् अर्थे प्रयुज्यमानानां शब्दानां, तथा नदीसंज्ञकशब्दानां सम्बुद्धि-एकवचनस्य प्रत्यये परे अङ्गस्य ह्रस्वादेशः भवति ।
7.3.107.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.108.v: For the short इ and उ final in a nominal-stem, a गुण is substituted in the Vocative Case singular.
7.3.108.e: If an अङ्ग ends in ह्रस्व letter, that ह्रस्व letter gets a गुणादेश in presence of the सुँ-प्रत्यय of सम्बोधन एकवचन.
7.3.108.sa: ह्रस्वान्तस्य अङ्गस्य सम्बोधन-एकवचनस्य सुँ-प्रत्यये परे गुणादेशः भवति ।
7.3.108.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.109.v: Before the affix अस् of the Nominative 1st-Case plural गुण is substituted for the final short vowel of a Nominal-stem.
7.3.109.e: If an अङ्ग ends in ह्रस्व letter, that ह्रस्व letter gets a गुणादेश in presence of the जस्-प्रत्यय.
7.3.109.sa: ह्रस्वान्तस्य अङ्गस्य जस्-प्रत्यये परे गुणादेशः भवति ।
7.3.109.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.110.v: गुण is substituted for the final ऋ of a अङ्ग (stem) in the Locative -7th case singular and in the strong cases.
7.3.110.e: The last letter of a ऋदन्त word is replaced by अर् in presence of  - (a) ङि-प्रत्यय and (b) a प्रत्यय that is also a सर्वनामस्थान.
7.3.110.sa: ऋदन्तस्य अङ्गस्य ङि-प्रत्यये परे सर्वनामस्थानप्रत्यये च परे गुणादेशः भवति ।
7.3.110.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.111.v: For the इ and उ of the stems called घि -- यू स्त्र्याख्यौ नदी [[1.4.3]], गुण is substituted in the Dative -4th Case, Ablative -5th case and Genitive 6th-Case singular.
7.3.111.e: A घि-संज्ञक अङ्ग gets a गुणादेश in presence of a ङित्-प्रत्यय.
7.3.111.sa: घि-संज्ञकस्य अङ्गस्य ङित्-प्रत्यये परे गुणादेशः भवति ।
7.3.111.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.112.v: The augment आट् is added to the case-endings of the Dative -4th Case, Ablative -5th case and Genitive 6th-Case singular after the stem called नदी -- यू स्त्र्याख्यौ नदी [[1.4.3]] etc.
7.3.112.e: A ङित्-प्रत्यय that comes after a नदीसंज्ञक अङ्ग get an आट् आगम.
7.3.112.sa: नदीसंज्ञकात् अङ्गात् परस्य ङित्-प्रत्ययस्य आट्-आगमः भवति ।
7.3.112.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.113.v: The augment याट् is added to the case-endings of the Dative -4th Case, Ablative -5th case and Genitive 6th-Case singular after a feminine अङ्ग (stem) ending in आ।
7.3.113.e: A ङित्-प्रत्यय that comes after an  आबन्त word get a याट् आगम.
7.3.113.sa: आबन्तात् अङ्गात् परस्य ङित्-प्रत्ययस्य याट्-आगमः भवति ।
7.3.113.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.114.v: After a Pronominal अङ्ग (stem) ending in long आ of the feminine, the Dative -4th Case, Ablative -5th case and Genitive 6th-Case singular get the augment स्याट् and the आ of the अङ्ग (stem) is shortened.
7.3.114.e: A ङित्-प्रत्यय that comes after an सर्वनामसंज्ञक आबन्त word get a स्याट् आगम, and the आबन्त अङ्ग gets a ह्रस्वादेश.
7.3.114.sa: सर्वनामसंज्ञकात् आबन्तात् परस्य ङित्-प्रत्ययस्य स्याट्-आगमः भवति, तथा च अङ्गस्य ह्रस्वः भवति ।
7.3.114.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.115.v: After द्वितीया and तृतीया the Dative -4th Case, Ablative -5th case and Genitive 6th-Case singular may optionally get the augment स्याट् before which the आ of the अङ्ग (stem) is shortened.
7.3.115.e: A ङित्-प्रत्यय that comes after the words द्वितीया and तृतीया optionally get a स्याट् आगम, and अङ्ग becomes ह्रस्व when such an आगम happens.
7.3.115.sa: 'द्वितीया'शब्दस्य विषये 'तृतीया'शब्दस्य विषये ङित्-प्रत्ययस्य स्याट्-आगमः तथा अङ्गस्य ह्रस्वः विकल्पेन भवति ।
7.3.115.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.116.v: For the ending इ of the Locative -7th case singular there is substituted आम् after a अङ्ग (stem) called नदी -- यू स्त्र्याख्यौ नदी [[1.4.3]] etc., after the feminines in आ and after नी।
7.3.116.e: The ङि-प्रत्यय gets आमादेश when it comes after -  (a) a नदीसंज्ञक word,  (b) an आबन्त word, and (c) a word that ends in 'नी'.
7.3.116.sa: नदीसंज्ञकात् परस्य, आबन्तात् परस्य, नीशब्दात् परस्य सप्तमीएकवचनस्य 'ङि'-प्रत्ययस्य आम्-आदेशः भवति ।
7.3.116.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.117.v: After all the feminine नदी -- यू स्त्र्याख्यौ नदी [[1.4.3]] etc., words ending in a short इ and उ , आम् is substituted for the इ of the Locative -7th case singular.
7.3.117.e: The ङि-प्रत्यय gets आमादेश when it comes after a ह्रस्व-इकारान्त or ह्रस्व-उकारान्त नदीसंज्ञक word.
7.3.117.sa: ह्रस्व-इकारान्त-ह्रस्व-उकारान्त-नदीसंज्ञकात् शब्दात् परस्य सप्तम्येकवचनस्य ङि-प्रत्ययस्य आम्-आदेशः भवति ।
7.3.117.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.118.v: After a अङ्ग (stem) ending in short इ and उ and which is not नदी -- यू स्त्र्याख्यौ नदी [[1.4.3]] or घि -- शेषो घ्यसखि [[1.4.7]], औ is substituted for the इ of the Locative -7th case singular.
7.3.118.e: The ङि-प्रत्यय gets औ आदेश when it comes after a ह्रस्व-इकारान्त or ह्रस्व-उकारान्त word.
7.3.118.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.119.v: After a घि -- शेषो घ्यसखि [[1.4.7]], अङ्ग (stem) ending in short इ or उ , औ is substituted for the इ of the Locative -7th case singular and अ is substituted for the final of such a घि अङ्ग (stem).
7.3.119.e: The ङि-प्रत्यय that comes after a घिसंज्ञक इकारान्त/उकारान्त word gets औ-आदेश, and the  भवति, and the last letter of the घिसंज्ञक अङ्ग gets an अकारादेश ।
7.3.119.sa: घिसंज्ञकात् इकारान्त-उकारान्तशब्दात् परस्य ङि-प्रत्ययस्य औत्-आदेशः भवति, तथा घिसंज्ञकस्य अङ्गस्य अन्तिमवर्णस्य अकारादेशः भवति ।
7.3.119.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

7.3.120.v: ना is substituted for the ending आ of the Instrumental -3rd case singular, after the घि अङ्ग (stems) when they are not feminine.
7.3.120.e: The आङ्-प्रत्यय that comes after a non-feminine घिसंज्ञक अङ्ग is converted to 'ना'.
7.3.120.sa: पुंलिङ्ग-नपुंसकलिङ्ग-घिसंज्ञकात् परस्य तृतीयैकवचनस्य टा-प्रत्ययस्य 'ना' आदेशः भवति ।
7.3.120.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation
